data.narrative:
Allen Control Systems is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Mike Wior, Steve Simoni, and Luke Allen that has raised $200M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 total comparables—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—filtered to same-sector and same-stage peers in Defense & Security.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($200M) as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, yields $380M. Peer-median analysis across 6 same-sector, same-stage companies (Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, Defense Unicorns at $1.0B, Heven AeroTech at $1.0B, and one additional peer) produces a median of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B.

These methods triangulate to a valuation range of $323M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $752M. The wide dispersion between stage-progression and peer-median reflects meaningful uncertainty around comparability—specifically, whether Allen Control's traction and market position align with the higher-valued peers or with earlier-stage benchmarks. Capital raised and stage-implied multiples suggest conservatism at the low end; peer medians suggest stronger positioning. Further diligence on growth trajectory, customer concentration, and defensibility would be needed to narrow this range.
